hold_reason: Refund for order 204 (11,000 cents) failed to record after 3 attempts; it is absent from the shared ledger. Human review is needed before payouts.

reply.thought: A refund for order 204 failed and was not recorded, so the ledger may not reflect the intended refunds. I’ll verify the orders and recorded refunds before deciding whether the batch is safe to pay.
